request:
Which source files of the httpx library itself (test code excluded) start with a module-level docstring? Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: This query finds all non-test files in the repository that have a heading labeled 'docstring', which corresponds to a module-level docstring. The file_id column stores the repository-relative file paths as requested.
sql:
SELECT f.file_id AS file_path
FROM code.files f
JOIN code.headings h ON f.file_id = h.file_id
WHERE h.heading = 'docstring'
  AND f.is_test = FALSE
ORDER BY f.file_id;
